description:
Amateur radio logbook software.

QLog is an Amateur Radio logging application for Linux, Windows. It is based on the Qt framework and uses SQLite as database backend.
QLogs aims to be as simple as possible, but to provide everything the operator expects from the log to be. This log is not currently focused on contests.
- Fixed inaccessible rig and rotator error dialogs. (PR #1237 @aa5sh)
- Fixed ADX - Omit characters forbidden by XML during export
- Fixed ADI - Removed invalid control characters after reading field values
- Fixed ESC Key to stop sending CW (issue #1228)
- ADX - Report XML import errors and reject incomplete records
- Updated Spanish translation (PR #1232 @dimarmnes)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/foldynl/QLog/compare/v0.54.1...v0.54.2
Windows Libraries:
Qt 6.11.1
hamlib 4.7.2
